articles.title_en: Russia–Ukraine peace talks conclude in Abu Dhabi with prisoner exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory
articles.lead_en: The trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States, held in Abu Dhabi on November 10–11, have ended. The head of the Russian delegation, Vladimir Medinsky, said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a prisoner exchange, and that the central topic of the talks was the European security system, on which the sides “found mutual understanding in some areas, but not in others.” As expected, there were no breakthroughs on the other topics.

articles.title_en: Russia, Ukraine, and the U.S. to hold peace talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10 — their first trilateral meeting since February, with security issues expected to top the agenda
articles.lead_en: The first trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States since February will begin on November 10 in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. European representatives will also attend, though they apparently will not take part in the trilateral talks themselves.
